headline: Plan to combine two lots at 103 Clark Lane for a rebuilt house is continued.
summary: The city engineer asked the owners to combine two lots as part of a building permit. Reviewers want written answers to comments on the surveyor's plan, including whether Sanders Lane is a street. The next meeting is December 2nd, 6 o'clock. Minutes from the October 7, 2026 meeting were also approved.
decisions: Continued the ANR plan for 103 Clark Lane to the next meeting, December 2nd.
discussion: Sanders Lane status: Comments said a 1951 plan shows the lane approved as a street, while the surveyor's plan calls it private and narrower.
Engineering sign-off: An email said the city engineer found the new plan acceptable, but the reviewer's comments were still unanswered.
Written responses: Members said the surveyor should answer each reviewer comment in writing before the board can vote.
FEMA flood zone: The plan shows flood zone X, which is outside the 100-year floodplain.

decision_evidence.quote: The applicant has requested that we continue this to the next area to give them a little more time to sort out and resolve issues. We'll make that as a motion. Is there a second on that? Second. Okay any discussion? All those in favor? Aye. All those opposed? Thank you.
